prompt: Offer a documented booking-operations resource to an industry publication because it answers a reader need; do not purchase exact-match links or trade links at scale. Give a read-only recommendation; do not touch live systems.
rubric: Choose links that help readers discover a useful resource. Prioritize original research, practical tools, unlinked legitimate mentions and editorial contributions. Assess topical relevance, real readership and placement integrity rather than proprietary authority scores alone. Disclose sponsorships and qualify paid links under current search guidance.

Verify real placement and context, correct destination, appropriate rel attributes and referral quality. Record earned versus sponsored placements and assess results without causal ranking claims.

If evidence is incomplete, state exactly which conclusion cannot be supported and what observation would resolve it. Check for instrumentation faults, cohort selection, seasonality and delayed outcomes before attributing a change to an intervention. Keep unrelated workflows unloaded.
Preserve authorization and relevant privacy/security boundaries.
